faq.q: How much does Cohen's Law Firm charge?
faq.a: Cohen's Law Firm publishes no fee terms on the pages we read, so none is recorded on this profile. An absence here is not a claim that the firm has no fee arrangement, only that it does not state one publicly. The rate itself is not published, so ask for it in writing, along with how case expenses are handled and whether they come out of the recovery before or after the fee. The first consultation is free, which is the place to ask.

faq.q: Does Cohen's Law Firm offer a free consultation?
faq.a: Yes. Cohen's Law Firm publishes a free initial consultation. The intake line is published as open around the clock.

faq.q: Where does Cohen's Law Firm have offices?
faq.a: Cohen's Law Firm publishes one office, in Kew Gardens. Addresses and the Google listing behind each one are on this profile under Offices.

faq.q: Who are the attorneys at Cohen's Law Firm?
faq.a: Cohen's Law Firm names three attorneys on its own site, and each is listed on this profile with the page we read them from. 1 of 3 named attorneys are currently registered and none carries an adverse status. 2 could not be told apart from namesakes in the register and are counted neither way.

faq.q: Are the case results Cohen's Law Firm publishes verified?
faq.a: No. Cohen's Law Firm publishes 28 case results with amounts on its own site. We counted them and we did not confirm them: the figures are the firm's. Pillar B scores whether a firm publishes outcomes and discloses them properly, including whether a prior-results disclaimer appears beside them, not whether the amounts are right. Past results do not predict another case.

faq.q: What has Law Firm Listings verified about Cohen's Law Firm?
faq.a: Cohen's Law Firm scores 57 and sits at Verified. Passed: licensure, discipline, website and footprint. Did not pass: entity registration. Every row of the scorecard above names where the value came from and when it was read. Nothing on this profile was supplied by the firm for payment, and no placement here can be bought.
